{{Quote|Is that so difficult to believe, Captain Solo? Yes, we have destroyed the other suspects: Hondo Bador, Cabot Lom, Nevid d'Hon, Berille Ada&mdash;anyone Mama might have angered by helping you.|Craitheus Qreph|<ref name="Crucible (novel)">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>}}
'''Hondo Bador''' was an [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who worked as a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] outfitting [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] ships. Bador was recommended to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] by [[Mama (information broker)|Mama]] as a potential source of information regarding the kidnapping of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Alfreda Goot]]. Although Bador had recently outfitted a "free-[[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]," his client was a male [[Human/Legends|human]] hoping to work away from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attention in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], and Bador had no knowledge of Goot.<ref name="SL" />

Bador was destroyed by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] as revenge for the shooting of [[Mama (information broker)|their mother]]. They did not know if Bador had done the deed, and had several suspects, so chose to destroy them all to be sure. Bador's private property was seized, and his friends and family [[Death/Legends|killed]].
